semantic_witnesses.what: 733 targeted formulas in six runs over the lookup family (documented examples, boundaries, argument errors and their order, kinds, wildcards, blank and omitted arguments, index truncation and overflow), and a sweep of 900 random lines of 1 to 24 cells of mixed kinds (numbers, text in two cases, logicals, #N/A, blank cells) with random lookup values, each against MATCH 1, -1 and 0, VLOOKUP TRUE, LOOKUP and 10 combinations of the match and search modes of XMATCH (13,500 results; a sixteenth formula of the second run, HLOOKUP over TRANSPOSE, gave #VALUE! in a legacy formula and is not used)
